description: This file defines a custom Flutter widget called MenuTile, which represents a tappable menu item with icon, title, subtitle, and enabled/disabled state.

classes.name: MenuTile
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a menu item as a Card containing an icon, title, subtitle, and optional trailing icon, with tap handling and enabled state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the MenuTile widget, returning a Card widget with an InkWell and ListTile to display icon and texts.
